timeline.legend: Each collection is a stripe in its own band: Sentinel-2 on top, Landsat in the middle, Planet as a bar across its month. A faded half-height stripe is over the cloud limit. The gold band is the alert window, where an image may show only part of the clearing: selectable, but never picked for you. The two handles above the timeline choose the images: the left one the before image, the right one the after image, and the bracket between them says how many days apart they are. Drag a handle and let it go on the image you want; the before handle cannot pass the after handle. Clicking a stripe moves the before handle if the image is left of it, the after handle if it is right of it, and between the two, the before handle for an image from before the alert start and the after handle otherwise. When two collections have an image on the same day, the handle takes Sentinel-2; click the Landsat stripe, or the button in the map title, to use Landsat instead. With the keyboard, Tab to a handle, move along the dates with the left and right arrow keys, jump to the first and last image with Home and End, and choose with Enter.

analysis_tile.description: Review each alert against its before and after imagery: give a verdict, answer the questions, then save and move on.
analysis_tile.info_md: The top bar holds the alert filter, the set selector, the review progress and **Previous** / **Next**; the counter between those two opens a menu to jump to an alert number or to the next unreviewed alert. The two maps show the before and after images picked on the shared timeline below them. Under **Verdict**, answer with one of the three buttons, then answer the project's questions under **Questions** (the loss driver by default); **Save** writes the review into the set's alert store and **Next** opens the following alert; with unsaved changes, Next asks whether to **Discard** them or **Stay**. **Refine polygon** opens the drawing tools and the two auto-detection models. **Export this alert**, at the bottom with Save and Next, lists the alert's files; once the alert is saved, **Build files** makes them: its GeoPackage, its before/after images, a Word report from the project's report template (chosen in the Questionnaire step) and, for a true alert, a **Timelapse** that animates its before and after images with the two images on either side, also included in the zip.
